name: Daisy Ever So Fresh Eau de Parfum
editorialDescription: A fruity floral eau de parfum in the Daisy family, in a peach-toned bottle with yellow, white and apricot daisies on the cap. Retailer listings that reproduce the brand's copy give mandarin, mango and pineapple on top, rosewater and orange blossom in the heart, and cashmere woods in the base — a juicier, sunnier variation than the original Daisy.
keyFeatures: Sephora lists key notes as mango, rose water and cashmere woods
advantages: Clear published notes for a tropical-fruit take on the Daisy line
An eau de parfum label, which brands generally use for a more concentrated formula than their eau de toilette
disadvantages: Concentration labels aren't regulated, so strength and wear time vary by formula and person
Tropical fruit notes are a matter of taste; try a sample if you usually prefer dry or green scents
suits: People who like bright, fruity florals
Anyone who finds the original Daisy too soft and wants something juicier
skipIf: You react to fragranced products or have fragrance allergy; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You want to smell it on your own skin before committing to a full bottle; look for a travel spray, mini or sample first
buyingConsiderations: Check the listing says Daisy Ever So Fresh and eau de parfum
Prefer listings sold by the brand or Amazon
